title: Risk knowledge scope
requirement: The ontology shall represent risk-related content and context without prescribing the risk-management process.
acceptance_criterion: Given a process description, only relevant information content is mapped; process-compliance claims are absent.
negative_acceptance_criterion: A RACI design or complete process lifecycle is inferred as mandatory ontology scope.

title: Case continuity
requirement: A RiskCase shall remain distinct from records, pattern specifications, scores and actual occurrences.
acceptance_criterion: A reassessment links to the same case while preserving separate result identity.
negative_acceptance_criterion: Equal text or scores automatically merge cases or create occurrences.

title: Source-qualified policy statements
requirement: Appetite and tolerance shall be stored as versioned statements with source meaning and context.
acceptance_criterion: Permissible-deviation and willingness-to-bear statements remain distinguishable.
negative_acceptance_criterion: Equal labels create equivalentClass or exactMatch assertions.

title: Boundary-aware standards review
requirement: The review shall record edition, inspected portions, semantic difference and access limitations.
acceptance_criterion: The report identifies accessible clauses and leaves uninspected scope unassessed.
negative_acceptance_criterion: Absence of inspected conflict is reported as full compliance.

title: Complete inventory disposition
requirement: Every inherited concept, association and generalization shall have a retained, revised or removed disposition.
acceptance_criterion: All prior IDs reconcile to the current registers or a reasoned removal ledger.
negative_acceptance_criterion: A prior item disappears silently or an unresolved stereotype is fabricated.

title: Temporal statement interpretation
requirement: Issued information, reference time and administrative state shall remain distinguishable.
acceptance_criterion: Closure alone cannot satisfy a test for cessation or treatment effectiveness.
negative_acceptance_criterion: A closed entry is interpreted as a ceased risk.

title: Threshold interpretation
requirement: Thresholds shall declare an indicator or scale anchor and compatible interpretation.
acceptance_criterion: Indicator-based and scale-only boundaries can be represented without inventing an indicator.
negative_acceptance_criterion: A scale-only threshold is rejected solely because a nonexistent indicator was not fabricated.

title: Evidence-qualified responsibility
requirement: Recorded assignment information shall be preserved even when a real responsibility relation cannot be grounded.
acceptance_criterion: A self-assignment source can be recorded without inventing a second actor.
negative_acceptance_criterion: A technical relation creates authority, accountability or a second actor without evidence.
